description: React component for sidebar board item with drag-and-drop, menu options, and view switching in a project related to boards and categories.

classes.name: SidebarBoardItem
classes.description: React component representing a sidebar item for a board, with functionalities like move, duplicate, hide, delete, and view switching.

methods.name: iconForViewType
methods.description: Returns the icon JSX element corresponding to a given view type.

methods.name: generateMoveToCategoryOptions
methods.description: Generates menu options for moving a board to different categories.

methods.name: handleDuplicateBoard
methods.description: Handles duplication of a board, optionally as a template, and updates category placement.

methods.name: showTemplatePicker
methods.description: Navigates to the team path to create a new template.

methods.name: handleHideBoard
methods.description: Hides the board and switches to another visible board or template picker if none are visible.
